items.text: In the internal medicine residency, will a three-part change package tested in PDSA cycles from October 2026 to March 2027 raise the weekly proportion of sampled workplace-based assessment comments meeting all three quality criteria from about 26 percent to at least 45 percent, without reducing the number of forms completed?
items.population: Written comments on mini clinical evaluation exercise and case-based discussion forms for 90 residents
items.intervention: Relabelled then split feedback prompts, micro-teaching at faculty meetings, and monthly individual reports
items.comparator: Eight weekly baseline points from August and September 2026 forms
items.outcome: Weekly proportion of 25 sampled comments meeting all three criteria
items.time: Eight baseline weeks, then about 24 weeks of PDSA cycles
items.setting: Internal medicine residency, one teaching hospital

finer: Feasible within approved time; interesting to residents, faculty and the committee; novel locally; ethical as QI with faculty reports kept private; relevant to progress decisions.
summary: One SMART QI aim with a baseline, a target and a balancing condition.
